chunk_text: These yogas are to be known from the Karakamsa ascendant and the natal ascendant. On the one hand the pair of Atmakaraka and Putrakaraka and on the other hand the natal ascendant lord and the 5th lord be considered. The effects due to such association will be full, or a half or a quarter according to their strengths.

MAHA RAJA YOGA .. Should the ascendant lord and the 5th lord exchange their signs or if Atma karaka and Putra Karaka (Chara) are in the ascendant, the 5th, exaltation sign, own sign or own Navamsa and aspected by a benefic, Maha Raja yoga is produced. The native so born will be famous and happy.
